summary: Support desk (support.py + /assistenza + /stanza/assistenza) tested end-to-end. Backend: 31/31 pytest pass (auth gating 401/403 on all admin+customer endpoints, cron 401/accepted/duplicate/400, relevant ticket -> Claude reply sent in ~10s status answered, follow-up -> 2nd AI reply, foreign ticket 404, invoice request -> needs_human with no AI message, auto_reply OFF -> AI draft hidden from user + needs_human, admin list counts/preview/filter, ai-draft, manual reply author admin sent true (drafts purged), PATCH status + 422/404, sync returns {new, fetched}). Frontend: footer link -> /assistenza, validation toast, category chips, submit -> ticket with support-waiting then 'Risposta inviata' via polling, follow-up inputs; /stanza admin-support-link -> inbox, filters with counts, toggle OFF/ON with toasts, sync, row -> detail with messages and INVIATA labels, BOZZA AI fills textarea, status select persists. 4 real emails sent in total. auto_reply restored to true (verified in DB).

minor.issue: Claude returns Markdown (**Profilo > Le tue misure**, **Analisi prodotto**). Shown as raw asterisks in the plain-text email, the HTML email, the /assistenza thread and the admin detail. Add 'no Markdown, plain text only' to the prompt and/or strip ** before sending.
AI overwrites ticket.category on every reply (user picked 'giacche', the follow-up about trousers changed it to 'pantaloni'). Consider setting it only when category is null (email tickets).
Drafts are deleted and status set to 'answered' before checking whether SMTP worked; if send fails you get a 502 but the ticket still says answered and the draft is gone.
A valid JSON body that is not an object (e.g. a list) makes (env or {}).get crash with a 500. Use isinstance(env, dict).
Follow-ups are accepted on closed tickets (the UI hides the input but the API allows it) and they reopen the ticket and trigger the AI.
Runs poll + AI + SMTP in the same request. With several new emails this can go past the ingress timeout. Consider running it in the background and returning early.

ui_bugs.issue: Changing the status calls load(), which runs setReply(draft||''). This wipes the AI draft or the manual reply being typed in admin-support-reply-input (reproduced: 955-char AI draft was cleared after the status change).
The unread gold dot stays on the row after it is opened, until the list reloads (onChanged is not called after the detail GET marks it read).

issues: Auto-reply Switch uses shadcn bg-primary/bg-input. On the #0A0A0A background the track is almost invisible, so only a white dot shows and ON vs OFF is hard to tell. Style the checked track gold (#D4AF37) and the unchecked one white/20.
Raw Markdown asterisks in AI replies (see backend minor).

action_items: Tell Claude to answer in plain text without Markdown (or strip **) in support.py SYSTEM_PROMPT
AdminSupport Detail: after a status change, don't overwrite the reply textarea (only set the draft on the first load)
Make the auto-reply Switch track visible on the dark background (gold when checked)
Optional: keep the user-chosen category; check the send result before deleting drafts / setting answered; isinstance check in the cron body; block follow-ups on closed tickets
critical_code_review_comments: IMAP read-only + BODY.PEEK confirmed in code; Sent copy goes to INBOX.Sent via APPEND; CC set on every send; Auto-Submitted header is set and checked for loop prevention. Good.
uvicorn WatchFiles also reloads on changes in backend/tests/*. A reload during a BackgroundTask can lose an in-flight AI reply (ticket stays 'open'). Not seen in prod, just a dev caveat.
